Subject: Audio recording of the Earnings Call held on July 23, 2026 for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 
 
Dear Sir/Madam,  
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the audio 
recording of the Company’s Earnings Call held on Thursday, July 23, 2026, pertaining to the financial 
performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 is available on the Company’s website at 
https://investor.igi.org/quarterly-financials/. 
 
This intimation will be made available on the Company’s website at www.igi.org. 
 
This is for your information and record.   
 
Thanking you,
